The '''compound''' of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Vengean|Vengean]] was a huge complex within the [[Sith Sanctum]], where the strongest warriors trained and followed the orders of their master.

==History==
During his time as a [[Dark Council]]or, [[Darth Vengean]] owned a compound where he gathered the strongest warriors of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and fulfilled his duties as the head of the [[Sphere of Military Offense]]. The compound had various rooms and corridors, as well as holding cells and a room with torture devices. However the most important locations where large areas where Vengean's followers could train their abilities, and a room where Vengean himself and his Sith could discuss about their goals and enemies.
